text: Tokyo Olympics, high jump final. Two old friends both cleared 2.37 m. Both missed three times at 2.39. The official said they could jump off for gold. Mutaz Barshim asked one question: *"Can we have two golds?"* The answer was yes. *They jumped into each other's arms.* Five years earlier, Gianmarco Tamberi broke his ankle and missed the Olympics. Now he had gold. Send this to your best friend.
